Where do you live? Seoul. Too short!
I live in Suwon, near Seoul.
I like it because it's quiet but close to the city.
There is a big park where I ride my bike on weekends.
Where do you live?
Simple present is used to talk about an action which happens on a regular basis.
I study English every day.
We use the present tense to talk about something that is true in the present.
I am a student.
Are you a student?
Yes, I am a student.
No, I am not a student.

She watches TV every night.

Why do you study English?
study. To spend time learning about a subject.
I study English because I want to work abroad someday.
English helps me talk with people from all over the world.
For example, I watch English videos every night.
How about you — why do you study it?
What is the hardest part of English for you?
Is English important for your future? Why?
If you could speak one more language, which one?
Where do you live?
live. To have your home in a place.
I live in Suwon, near Seoul.
I like it because it's quiet but close to the city.
There is a big park where I ride my bike on weekends.
Where do you live?
What is the best thing about your neighborhood?
What would you change about your town?
Where would you like to live in the future?
What is your favorite TV show?
watch. To look at something for a period of time.
My favorite show is Running Man.
The members are hilarious and the games are creative.
I usually watch it with my family on Sunday nights.
Have you seen it?
Do you prefer TV shows or YouTube? Why?
Which person on the show would you like to meet?
Is watching TV a waste of time? Why or why not?
Do you have a pet?
pet. An animal you keep at home for fun and company.
No, I don't, but I really want a dog.
Dogs are loyal and they make people happy.
My neighbor has a golden retriever, and I play with him every weekend.
Do you think pets are a lot of work?
What is the hardest part of having a pet?
Should pets be allowed in every apartment?
What unusual pet would you like to have?
What is your favorite sport?
sport. A physical game where players or teams compete.
My favorite sport is basketball.
I enjoy it because it's fast and you need teamwork.
I play with my friends at the school court twice a week.
Which sport do you like to watch?
Do you prefer team sports or individual sports?
Which sports star do you admire? Why?
Should schools have more PE classes?
What is the best thing about your friend?
best. Better than all the others.
The best thing about my friend Jisoo is that she's a great listener.
When I'm stressed, she always listens to me.
Last month she helped me get ready for a big test.
What makes someone a good friend to you?
How did you meet your best friend?
Is it better to have many friends or a few close ones?
Have you ever argued with a friend? What happened?
What is one thing you want to learn?
learn. To get a new skill or knowledge.
I want to learn how to play the guitar.
It would be amazing to play songs for my friends.
I've watched some online lessons, but I need a real teacher.
What would you like to learn this year?
Is it better to learn from a teacher or from videos?
What skill will be important in the future?
How long does it take to learn a new skill?
How can you help other people?
help. To make it easier for someone to do something.
I can help people by volunteering in my community.
Helping others makes me feel useful and happy.
Last year I picked up trash in the park with my classmates.
How do you help people around you?
Why do some people volunteer?
What small thing can make someone's day better?
Should students do volunteer work at school?
What would you like to teach someone?
teach. To show someone how to do something.
I would like to teach my little brother how to ride a bike.
I remember how proud I felt when I learned it.
I'd hold the back of the seat and let go slowly.
What would you be good at teaching?
Who is the best teacher you've ever had? Why?
What makes a good teacher?
Would you like to be a teacher someday?
What are your hobbies?
hobby. Something you do for fun in your free time.
My hobbies are baking and photography.
Baking relaxes me, and I love sharing cookies with my family.
I also take photos of my food and post them online.
What do you do in your free time?
How did you start your hobby?
Can a hobby become a job? Give an example.
What new hobby would you like to try?
